items.text: PBs all over Málaga — sun, sangria and a few people still walking funny. Worth it.
New faces at Sunday Service — if you see someone lost by the sleds, you're the welcome committee now.
Next race trip is filling up — put your name on the board and we'll sort the hotel together.
Thursday Engine is where the doubles pairs are quietly forming. Partner board's live, claim your lane.
Stay tuned for more & stay authentic. See you Sunday, 8am. — Ross

followUp.text: Sunday Service, done. Coffee after, as promised.
